group.title: Moving a display into a showroom

turns.text: We need to move the long display case from the van to the upstairs showroom. Both lifts can carry it, but the public lift is the only step-free route for visitors. We need to leave it free from ten onward.
The freight lift is booked until ten thirty. We need the lift and both movers for the full twenty minutes. One of them leaves at eleven.
We could take the case into the office now and send it upstairs later.
Let's not give the case a guided tour. Once it leaves the van, someone has to check the seals at every handover. The driver can wait here until we take it upstairs.

One more thing. At eleven, the booking screen will mark the room available. The setup team can plug the display in as soon as it is in place, but Facilities won't inspect the finished setup until eleven thirty.

The screen only shows whether someone booked the room. Before opening the doors, the welcome desk needs confirmation that the room is safe for visitors. With a powered display, only Facilities can issue that clearance.

group.passageZh:
女：我們要把廂型車上的長展示櫃搬到樓上的展示間。兩部電梯都載得 動，但客用電梯是訪客唯一不必走階梯的路線。從十點開始，必須留給訪客使用。
男：貨梯已被預約到十點半。搬運全程二十分鐘都需要使用電梯，兩位搬運人員也都得在場。其中一位十一點就要離開。
男：我們可以先把展示櫃搬進辦公室，稍後再送上樓。
女：就別帶展示櫃到處「參觀」了。展示櫃一離開廂型車，每次交接都要 有人查驗封條。司機可以在這裡等到我們把展示櫃搬上樓。
男：還有一件事。十一點時，預約畫面會把展示間標示為可以使用。 展示櫃就位後，布置人員可以立即插電，但設施管理組要到十一點半 才會檢查布置完成的展示間。
女：畫面只顯示有沒有人預約展示間。接待櫃檯必須先收到確認現場安全的通知，才能讓訪客進場。展示設備需要通電時，只有設施管理組能核准開放。

questions.prompt: Which proposed move fits the lift and staffing arrangements?
questions.promptZh: 哪個搬運方案符合電梯使用及人員安排？

options.text: Start using the public lift at ten oh five.
options.zh: 十點零五分開始使用客用電梯搬運。
options.whyZh: 客用電梯載得動展示櫃，但十點起須留給需要無階梯動線的訪客。

options.text: Start using the freight lift at ten thirty-five.
options.zh: 十點三十五分開始使用貨梯搬運。
options.whyZh: 貨梯十點半後有空，十點三十五分開始，預留二十分鐘後約   十點五十五分完成，兩位搬運人員都能全程在場。

options.text: Start using the freight lift at ten fifty.
options.zh: 十點五十分開始使用貨梯搬運。
options.whyZh: 貨梯雖已空出，但預留二十分鐘會到十一點十分；其中一位   搬運人員十一點必須離開。

options.text: Start using the freight lift at ten ten.
options.zh: 十點十分開始使用貨梯搬運。
options.whyZh: 這時兩人雖可到場，但貨梯仍由其他人預約，要等到十點半。

questions.prompt: What does the woman mean when she says, “Let's not give the case a guided tour”?
questions.promptZh: 女子說「就別帶展示櫃到處『參觀』了」是什麼意思？

options.text: She thinks a worker should guide visitors while the case is being moved.
options.zh: 她覺得搬展示櫃時應安排一位人員為訪客帶路。
options.whyZh: 這句玩笑是回應把展示櫃先搬進辦公室的提議，不是在安排訪客導覽。

options.text: She wants to move the case out of the van promptly so the driver does not have to wait.
options.zh: 她想儘快把展示櫃搬出廂型車，不讓司機等候。
options.whyZh: 她說司機可以等到直接搬上樓，不需要先卸下展示櫃。

options.text: She prefers leaving the case in the office until someone can replace its seals.
options.zh: 她偏好先把展示櫃留在辦公室，等有人能更換封條。
options.whyZh: 對話說交接時必須查驗封條，沒說封條要更換。她也不是在建議先搬進辦公室。

options.text: She wants to avoid a stop in the office that would add another handover.
options.zh: 她想避免先搬進辦公室，增加一次多餘的交接。
options.whyZh: 「到處參觀」把展示櫃擬人化，實際是在反對先搬進辦公室再搬上樓。   多一次交接就要多做一次封條查驗，而司機可留在原地等候。

questions.evidence: We could take the case into the office now and send it upstairs later. | Let's not give the case a guided tour. Once it leaves the van, someone has to check the seals at every handover. The driver can wait here until we take it upstairs.

questions.prompt: Suppose the display is already running when the room appears as available at eleven. How should the welcome desk respond?
questions.promptZh: 假設十一點時預約畫面顯示展示間可用，展示設備也已在運作。 接待櫃檯應該怎麼處理？

options.text: Admit visitors as soon as the booking screen changes.
options.zh: 預約畫面一變更，就讓訪客進去。
options.whyZh: 畫面只顯示預約狀態，不能當作現場檢查已獲核准。

options.text: Keep visitors outside until Facilities approves the setup.
options.zh: 先請訪客在外等候，等設施管理組核准布置後再開放。
options.whyZh: 設備運作與預約畫面都不等於檢查核准。設施管理組十一點半   才檢查，收到核准之後才能讓訪客進去。

options.text: Admit visitors at eleven thirty even if Facilities has not cleared the setup.
options.zh: 即使設施管理組尚未核准布置，也在十一點半讓訪客進去。
options.whyZh: 十一點半是檢查時間，不等於一定會在那一刻核准。

options.text: Keep visitors outside until the setup team plugs in the display again.
options.zh: 等布置人員再一次把展示設備插電，才讓訪客進去。
options.whyZh: 設備已在運作，也沒有要求重新插電；能不能進場取決於設施管理組的核准。
